The first paragraph. Its spaces, tabs and line breaks collapse into one space.

A second paragraph with a line break
here, and two

there.

Text outside any paragraph
A division starts a new line
and so does the next one.

Leading and trailing whitespace in a paragraph is dropped.

Empty paragraphs above and below leave one blank line, not several.

A non-breaking  space stays, but not at the end of a line:

Inline bold, italic, code and spans are plain text.
